verifications.claim: Sam’s Club is closed on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Sam's Club is closed on New Year's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas." (R1); "No, both Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will be closed on April 5." (R2); "Sam's Club... will be closed." (R3); "Sam's Club will not be open on Easter Sunday." (R5); "Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will both be closed on April 5" (R6); "Easter: Closed" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Sam's Club is closed on Easter Sunday.

verifications.claim: Sam’s Club closes all locations on Easter Sunday to allow employees to spend time with family.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "both Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will be closed" (R2, implies all); "stores like Sam's and Costco are closing for Easter Sunday. These stores are starting to take seriously the need for their employees to have time off on important holidays with family." (R5); "Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will both be closed" (R6, implies all); "Easter: Closed" (R7, official)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm all locations closed; R5 directly provides the reason of allowing employee family time.

verifications.claim: According to Sam's Club's official holiday schedule, Sam's Club is closed on Easter.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R7 is Sam's Club's official help center listing Easter as closed.

verifications.claim: According to Sam's Club's official holiday schedule, Sam's Club is closed on New Year's Day.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "New Year’s Day ... Closed" (R1, sourced from Sam's); "New Year's Day: Closed" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R7 official schedule and R1 confirm closure on New Year's Day.

verifications.claim: According to Sam's Club's official holiday schedule, Sam's Club is closed on Thanksgiving.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R7 official schedule and R1 confirm closure on Thanksgiving.

verifications.claim: According to Sam's Club's official holiday schedule, Sam's Club is closed on Christmas.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R7 official schedule and R1 confirm closure on Christmas.

verifications.claim: Walmart is a sister company of Sam's Club.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "the Walmart subsidiary’s retail warehouses" (R1); "its associated store, Sam's Club" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Sam's Club as Walmart subsidiary/associated, not sister company (which implies peer under common parent); contradicts claim.

verifications.claim: Walmart is open with regular hours on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Walmart will be open regular hours on Easter." (R2); "Walmart will be open on Easter Sunday" (R5); "Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Walmart open regular hours on Easter.
